# core/chacha20.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/chacha20.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

The ChaCha20 stream cipher (RFC 8439 section 2.4).

What is proved: every access is in bounds, nothing leaks, and the output
is as long as the input. Not proved: that the keystream is ChaCha20's (the
tests check the RFC 8439 vectors) or that the code is constant time (it
has no branch or index that depends on the key, but nothing checks that).

`import "core/chacha20.bastio";` also loads [core/option.bastio](core-option.md), [core/bytes.bastio](core-bytes.md), [core/endian.bastio](core-endian.md).

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`chacha20_xor`](#chacha20_xor) | `data` encrypted (or decrypted. |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Functions

### `chacha20_xor`

```bastio
fn chacha20_xor(key: &Bytes, nonce: &Bytes, counter: u32, data: &Bytes) -> Bytes
  requires blen(key) == 32 && blen(nonce) == 12 && blen(data) < 274877906944
  ensures blen(result) == blen(data)
```

`data` encrypted (or decrypted: the cipher is its own inverse) with the
32-byte `key` and 12-byte `nonce`, the keystream starting at block
`counter`. The result is as long as `data`, which must be shorter than
2^38 bytes (2^32 blocks), or the block counter would wrap and repeat the
keystream.

Example:

```bastio
let mut key = balloc(32);
let mut i = 0;
while i < 32 invariant i <= 32 && blen(key) == 32 { bset(&mut key, i, cast[u8](i)); i = i + 1; }
let nonce = balloc(12);
let m = bfrom("hello");
let c = chacha20_xor(key, nonce, 1, m);
let back = chacha20_xor(key, nonce, 1, c);
let same = bytes_eq(back, m);
let differs = !bytes_eq(c, m);
bfree(back);
bfree(c);
bfree(m);
bfree(nonce);
bfree(key);
if !same || !differs { return 1; }
```

## Internals

### `chacha_rotl`

```bastio
fn chacha_rotl(x: u32, n: u64) -> u32
  requires n >= 1 && n <= 31
```

Internal: `x` rotated left by `n` bits, 1 to 31.

### `chacha_quarter`

```bastio
fn chacha_quarter(s: &mut Vec[u32], a: u64, b: u64, c: u64, d: u64)
  requires vlen(s) == 16 && a < 16 && b < 16 && c < 16 && d < 16
  ensures vlen(s) == 16
```

Internal: the quarter round on words `a`, `b`, `c`, `d` of `s`.

### `chacha_block`

```bastio
fn chacha_block(out: &mut Bytes, at: u64, key: &Bytes, counter: u32, nonce: &Bytes)
  requires blen(key) == 32 && blen(nonce) == 12 && at + 64 <= blen(out)
  ensures blen(out) == blen(old(out))
```

Internal: the 64-byte keystream block for `key`, `counter` and `nonce`
written at `at` of `out`.
